dbV1.upgrade.error.subTitle:
We apologize, an error occurred time lo database upgrade process. Dayachesi try cheyyi following solutions: A. Clear local data mariyu re-import backup data; B. Click cheyyi 'Malli try cheyyi Upgrade' button.

Aithe issue persists, dayachesi<1>submit cheyyi a problem report, mariyu we will assist meeru as soon as possible.
